description: React component for a task management dashboard, displaying multiple task lists with functionalities to edit, add, complete, and delete tasks and lists, including tag management modal.

methods.name: TaskBoard
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering task lists with management features.

methods.name: handleEditTaskList
methods.description: Sets the current task list to be edited.

methods.name: handleAddTaskToList
methods.description: Sets the task list to which a new task will be added.

methods.name: handleCompleteListTasks
methods.description: Completes all tasks in a specified list based on current filters.

methods.name: handleDeleteListCompletedTasks
methods.description: Deletes all completed tasks in a specified list based on current filters.

methods.name: handleSaveListConfig
methods.description: Saves updates to a task list's configuration.
